test_title: PYST 07: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : QVR :: CHD : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : QVR :: CHD : %

Option 1) # = LJM, % = NHG → LJM : QVR :: CHD : NHG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4aea4d4b39f26babc99952569859606922f320edc5d845ab2b93cd36bc5dd4a.png] 

Option 2) # = GYT, % = NYU → GYT : QVR :: CHD : NYU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f9d4d0516cead6fac5f642f164fa6bc637e77da1b8674b93c788fe8e90d431d.png] 

Option 3) # = PMM, % = JUY → PMM : QVR :: CHD : JUY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ee8e168d09ae5328dbaf94cf958f5b4ff5c22b7ea6215bfe7f59714a83b1731.png] 

Option 4) # = LQM, % = HMI → LQM : QVR :: CHD : HMI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e4505a3b4bab41f323c152e8b1ebaa79d940ef90e749c610132b832169ad659.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
